in_marathi.name: Bharatsinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of war Bharata's Lion-God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharatsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharatsinh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bharata' and 'Sinh'. Bharata is the name of the legendary king of Hastinapur in the Indian epic Mahabharata. Sinh means lion. The name Bharatsinh can be translated as 'God of war Bharata's Lion-God'.
